content.short: Lore enables collectives to spin up a shared vault, pool resources and own NFTs together.
content.description: Lore provides on-chain fundraising and investment capabilities for DAOs and communities. It's used by well-known DAOs such as Moonbird and Crypto Coven to organize and monitor fundraising, showing how much has been raised in real time. In addition, Lore offers an investment module that lets groups pool resources to purchase blue-chip NFTs together, enabling collective ownership and decision-making. Lore supports multiple chains and DAO workflows, making fundraising and collaborative investing more transparent and efficient.
